text: Name a champion whose full official name is four letters or fewer
rule: Count only the letters in the champion's official name.

text: Name a champion who can become invisible
rule: One of the champion's own abilities makes them Invisible or Camouflaged, even if only after an upgrade or evolution (e.g. Kai'Sa's evolved Supercharge).

text: Name a champion with a dash or leap (blinks and teleports don't count)
rule: One of the champion's own abilities moves them quickly across the ground or through the air to a location or target: dashes, leaps, lunges and hops all count.

text: Name a champion who can pull an enemy
rule: One of the champion's own abilities forcibly moves an enemy toward the champion or toward a point (hooks, pulls, drags).

text: Name a champion who can stun
rule: One of the champion's own abilities Stuns an enemy, including conditional stuns (e.g. into a wall).

text: Name a champion who can knock up an enemy
rule: One of the champion's own abilities Knocks Up (airborne in place or lifted) an enemy.

text: Name a champion with a global ultimate
rule: The champion's own ultimate (R) can reach any point on the map: unlimited range or map-wide effect.

text: Name a player who won Worlds
rule: Any player listed on the winning team's roster at any World Championship so far (Season 1 onward), substitutes included. Coaches don't count. Leaguepedia's roster is the source.

text: Name a ranged champion who can become invisible
rule: A ranged champion where one of their own abilities makes them Invisible or Camouflaged, even if only after an upgrade or evolution. Ranged means a base attack range of 300 or more; transforming champions count by their base form (Kayle, Gnar and Jayce are melee, Nidalee and Elise ranged).

text: Name a melee champion who can pull an enemy
rule: A melee champion where one of their own abilities forcibly moves an enemy toward them or toward a point (hooks, pulls, drags). Melee means a base attack range under 300; transforming champions count by their base form (Kayle, Gnar and Jayce are melee, Nidalee and Elise ranged).

text: Name a ranged champion who can knock up an enemy
rule: A ranged champion where one of their own abilities Knocks Up an enemy. Ranged means a base attack range of 300 or more; transforming champions count by their base form (Kayle, Gnar and Jayce are melee, Nidalee and Elise ranged).

text: Name a ranged champion with a global ultimate
rule: A ranged champion where their own ultimate (R) can reach any point on the map. Ranged means a base attack range of 300 or more; transforming champions count by their base form (Kayle, Gnar and Jayce are melee, Nidalee and Elise ranged).

text: Name a champion who can both dash and become invisible
rule: Both apply: one of their own abilities makes them Invisible or Camouflaged, even if only after an upgrade or evolution, and one of their own abilities dashes, leaps, lunges or hops them to a location or target (blinks and teleports don't count). The two can come from different abilities.

text: Name a champion who can both pull and stun an enemy
rule: Both apply: one of their own abilities forcibly moves an enemy toward them or toward a point (hooks, pulls, drags), and one of their own abilities Stuns an enemy, including conditional stuns. The two can come from different abilities.
